title: Trebuchet?!
description: Extract calibration values from first and last digits in each line.
writeup:
## Approach

Each line encodes a two-digit calibration value formed by the first and last digit found in the string. The trick is defining what counts as a "digit".

## Part 1

Only numeric characters (`0`–`9`) count. Find the first and last, concatenate them into a two-digit number, and sum across all lines.

## Part 2

Spelled-out digits (`one` through `nine`) now also count. The key subtlety is that words can overlap — `twone` contains both `two` and `one` — so you must check for matches at every position independently rather than consuming characters as you go.
